name: EvoWiki
description: EvoWiki is an evolving dataset benchmark designed to evaluate how well Large Language Models adapt to evolving knowledge by categorizing information into stable, evolved, and uncharted states. It is fully auto-updatable, enabling precise evaluation of continuously changing knowledge and newly released LLMs, highlighting challenges in handling evolved knowledge.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited community adoption so far, but notable for targeting evolving knowledge rather than static factual recall.
notes: Highlights the synergy between retrieval-augmented generation and continual learning for adapting to evolving knowledge.
